final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(oi.product_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM Products AS p LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code COLLATE BINARY = p.production_type_code COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(item_count) AS total_count FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.product_type_description, s1.avg_quantity, s1.item_count, 1.0 * s1.item_count / NULLIF(s2.total_count, 0) AS item_share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total_count IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(item_count) AS avg_count, AVG(item_share) AS avg_share FROM s3 GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity), AVG(avg_count), AVG(avg_share) FROM s4
